android.desc:
Four Word Game is a game where you arrange four different words in a 4 X 4 grid such that the grid should read the same whether you read it horizontally or vertically. See the screenshots for a few examples.

In this game, you start with 16 letters that are scrambled in a 4 X 4 grid. All you need to do is drag and drop the letters to make the grid read the same in rows and columns. The letters are color coded in Wordle style i.e. 
Green Letters indicate they are in the correct position
Yellow Letters indicate they are in that row but not in the correct position. 
Grey Letters indicate the letter is not in the row.
(Note: Yellow only means the letter is in the row, not in the column)

Of course this is easy right - what's the big deal? The challenge is you only get 15 swaps to set each grid straight. The initial word grids are easy since they already have 3 to 4 letters in the correct positions. But as you go further, the grids get harder. 

Finish the grid with minimum swaps and you will get candies that you can use to unlock  features as you progress. Each swap left at the end is worth one candy.  But wait there's more! You also get bonus candy rounds in between. Bonus candy rounds give you extra candies for completing the grid within a specified time as well. 

Sounds exciting?! Well the game sure is addictive and will keep you engaged for hours. This game can be played completely in offline mode with over 250 grids inside the app. 

If you want to sample this game before downloading the app, you can also play it on our website: https://fourwordgrid.web.app/
